cases.question: Where did Rashad announce that he was a messenger of God?
cases.expected_answer_note: He announces a divine commission near the beginning and says he had known since 1980.

cases.question: When did Rashad say he first knew he was a messenger?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says he had known since 1980.

cases.question: Why did Rashad wait eight years to announce his claim?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says he feared appearing superior and feared the personal consequences.

cases.question: Did Rashad think a messenger is better than everyone else?
cases.expected_answer_note: No. He says a messenger is an ordinary human and may be less righteous than others.

cases.question: How did Rashad use Khidr and Moses to explain messengership?
cases.expected_answer_note: He refers to Moses being taught by one of God's servants to show a messenger is not necessarily superior.

cases.question: Did Rashad say a messenger can go to hell?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says messengership does not guarantee heaven and cites the warning against idolatry.

cases.question: Did Rashad accept money for religious work?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says he would not allow religious income into his personal pocket.

cases.question: How did Rashad say a messenger's information should be tested?
cases.expected_answer_note: It must conform to the whole Quran and introduce no unsupported innovation.

cases.question: What did Rashad mean by Quran alone?
cases.expected_answer_note: He treats the Quran as the sole criterion and rejects words of men or innovations.

cases.question: Did Rashad believe Muhammad was the last messenger?
cases.expected_answer_note: No. He says Muhammad was the final prophet, while later messengers remain possible.

cases.question: What is the difference between a prophet and a messenger according to Rashad?
cases.expected_answer_note: He defines a prophet as receiving scripture and a messenger as confirming existing scripture.

cases.question: How did Rashad interpret the seal of the prophets?
cases.expected_answer_note: He interprets it as finality of prophethood, not finality of all messengership.

cases.question: How did Rashad use Quran 3:81 to support his claim?
cases.expected_answer_note: He reads it as a covenant to believe in and support a later messenger confirming scripture.

cases.question: Why did Rashad say a new messenger is a test of ego?
cases.expected_answer_note: People may reject an ordinary human who appears to claim leadership or attention.

cases.question: Which other people claiming messengership did Rashad mention?
cases.expected_answer_note: Bahaullah, Ghulam Ahmad, and Joseph Smith.

cases.question: What proof did Rashad say a true messenger must bring?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says a messenger must bring signs and presents the mathematical code as his proof.

cases.question: What did Rashad say the number 118123 represents?
cases.expected_answer_note: The claimed sum of the verse numbers of all verses containing the word God.

cases.question: Did Rashad say his name was encoded in the Quran?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes. He connects Rashada and Khalifa occurrences and numerical sums with his name.

cases.question: What was the Abraham, Muhammad, and Rashad triangle?
cases.expected_answer_note: Abraham brought the practices, Muhammad brought the Quran, and Rashad claimed to bring the proof.

cases.question: Did Rashad say people who die before forty go to heaven?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes, he presents this as a Quranic secret.

cases.question: What did the button about age forty say?
cases.expected_answer_note: Everything up to the age of forty is just rehearsal.

cases.question: What was Rashad's method of zakat?
cases.expected_answer_note: He prescribes 2.5 percent of net income when received, with brief accumulation permitted.

cases.question: Who did Rashad say should receive zakat first?
cases.expected_answer_note: Parents first, then relatives, orphans, poor people, and stranded travelers.

cases.question: What did Beth say about Rashad's messenger announcement?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad recalls her saying she had known all along and supported him.

cases.question: Did Rashad practice bibliomancy with the Quran?
cases.expected_answer_note: He repeatedly opened Qurans at random and interpreted the passages as direct messages. Bibliomancy is a modern label, not his wording.

cases.question: How did Rashad say God fired and restored him?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says random Quran openings repeatedly conveyed condemnation until he resolved to announce, after which they conveyed forgiveness.

cases.question: Why did Rashad say his announcement sifted believers?
cases.expected_answer_note: He treats acceptance of a human messenger as one of the tests along the road to God.

cases.question: What did Rashad say the Quranic shahada is?
cases.expected_answer_note: There is no god except God, without adding Muhammad's name.

cases.question: Did Rashad propose adding his own name to the shahada?
cases.expected_answer_note: He uses that formula rhetorically to challenge the practice of adding Muhammad's name.

cases.question: Did Rashad say he was under a death sentence?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says Saudi Arabia and Iran were among countries where he faced a death sentence. This should be attributed as his historical assertion.

cases.question: When was the Quran code first published according to Rashad?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says an initial article appeared in January 1973 and the first report on nineteen in November 1973.

cases.question: What did Rashad say happened in 1980 or 1400 AH?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says he first knew his messenger role and interprets the year as the beginning of a new stage.

cases.question: What did Rashad say about Arabs accepting the Quran code?
cases.expected_answer_note: He polemically claims that Arabs from the Arabian Peninsula had not accepted it.

cases.question: What names did Rashad remove from salat?
cases.expected_answer_note: He rejects mentioning Muhammad and his family or Abraham and his family during salat.

cases.question: How did Rashad determine the start and end of Ramadan?
cases.expected_answer_note: He favors computer-based astronomical calculation over visual moon sighting.

cases.question: Did Rashad consider visiting Medina part of Hajj?
cases.expected_answer_note: No. He calls tomb visitation in Medina non-Quranic and idolatrous.

cases.question: Why did Rashad say the public messenger announcement was necessary?
cases.expected_answer_note: He says God had a purpose even though Rashad had preferred simply to spread the message.

cases.question: How did Rashad use Joseph to reject the idea of a final messenger?
cases.expected_answer_note: He cites people saying no messenger would come after Joseph despite many later messengers.

cases.question: Why did Rashad think the computer age needed a messenger?
cases.expected_answer_note: He points to population growth and modern science, computers, technology, and video.

cases.question: What does Old Message, New Messenger mean?
cases.expected_answer_note: The messenger is new, while the message remains worship of God alone and adherence to God's word.

cases.question: Does the transcript repeat material near the end?
cases.expected_answer_note: Yes. It repeats Ya-Sin and substantial portions of the ritual-reform discussion.

cases.question: Should the repeated ending count as independent corroboration?
cases.expected_answer_note: No. It is duplicate or reprised material within the same recording and should be down-weighted.
